interpretation: The native ICE component and full-matrix native ICE pass after sealed Store control-read fix; this does not qualify every native SDK transition.
Clean baseline, original-peer EdDSA/ES256 ICE restart and both unreachable TURN cases pass with actual changing decoded pixels and unchanged quality predicates.
All four distinct-network UDP/TCP relay cells pass, including original ICE recovery, decoded media, zero final TURN allocations and normal cleanup.
Both direct bridges meet decoded motion, audio identity and source identity; one peer per cell exceeds strict AV p95:143.30ms EdDSA and121.20ms ES256. 120ms limit remains unchanged.

Impairment retains outside-burst audio identity failures and unexcluded motion gaps over2s. Video recovery within2s is separately passed; degraded AV advisory does not excuse audio or motion failures.
The subsequent script-only full producer reused the completed build in0.415s. The earlier Store-change rebuilds took about30–36minutes. No runtime conclusion is drawn from build duration.
Empty legacy server media diagnostic arrays remain unmeasured, not a zero-loss assertion.
